title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
text: previous section created basic RO-Crate rocrateR::rocrate() function; however, likely include additional entities RO-Crate. Entities must contain least two components @id @type (see https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/ details). example, contextual entity can defined follows: two can linked via @id field: entities can attached RO-Crate using rocrateR::add_entity() function: Alternatively, result can achieved following code:
code: # create entity for an organisation organisation_uol <- rocrateR::entity(   x = "https://ror.org/04xs57h96",   type = "Organization",   name = "University of Liverpool",   url = "http://www.liv.ac.uk" )  # create an entity for a person person_rvd <- rocrateR::entity(   x = "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5036-8661",   type = "Person",   name = "Roberto Villegas-Diaz" ) person_rvd$affiliation <- list(`@id` = organisation_uol$`@id`) my_second_ro_crate <- rocrateR::rocrate() |>   rocrateR::add_entity(person_rvd) |>   rocrateR::add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "author", value = list(`@id` = person_rvd$`@id`)) |>   rocrateR::add_entity(organisation_uol) my_second_ro_crate <- rocrateR::rocrate(person_rvd, organisation_uol) |>   rocrateR::add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "author", value = list(`@id` = person_rvd$`@id`)) print(my_second_ro_crate) #> { #>   "@context": "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/context", #>   "@graph": [ #>     { #>       "@id": "ro-crate-metadata.json", #>       "@type": "CreativeWork", #>       "about": { #>         "@id": "./" #>       }, #>       "conformsTo": { #>         "@id": "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2" #>       } #>     }, #>     { #>       "@id": "./", #>       "@type": "Dataset", #>       "name": "", #>       "description": "", #>       "datePublished": "2025-11-04", #>       "license": { #>         "@id": "http://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0" #>       }, #>       "author": { #>         "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5036-8661" #>       } #>     }, #>     { #>       "@id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5036-8661", #>       "@type": "Person", #>       "name": "Roberto Villegas-Diaz", #>       "affiliation": { #>         "@id": "https://ror.org/04xs57h96" #>       } #>     }, #>     { #>       "@id": "https://ror.org/04xs57h96", #>       "@type": "Organization", #>       "name": "University of Liverpool", #>       "url": "http://www.liv.ac.uk" #>     } #>   ] #> }

title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
text: explore BagIt file packaging format, recommended use bagging RO-Crates. BagIt described RFC 8493: [BagIt ] … set hierarchical file layout conventions storage transfer arbitrary digital content. “bag” just enough structure enclose descriptive metadata “tags” file “payload” require knowledge payload’s internal semantics. BagIt format suitable reliable storage transfer. package, function rocrateR::bag_rocrate take either path pointing root RO-Crate (must least RO-Crate metadata descriptor file, ro-crate-metadata.json) RO-Crate object created rocrateR::rocrate (alternatives), shown step 1. details, run following command:

title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
text: create RO-Crate bag inside temporary directory:
code: # create basic RO-Crate basic_ro_crate <- rocrateR::rocrate()  # create temporary directory tmp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("rocrate-", digest::digest(Sys.time()))) dir.create(tmp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)  # then, we can create the RO-Crate bag path_to_rocrate_bag <- basic_ro_crate |>   rocrateR::bag_rocrate(path = tmp_dir) #> RO-Crate successfully 'bagged'! #> For details, see: /tmp/RtmpJDledw/rocrate-dc0b8f71bc4ab2e85c9c47e17b4c6cfc/rocrate-198ae50c2d60ae04b7a9a2da24243c5e.zip

title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
text: can use function rocrateR::is_rocrate_bag() verify given path points ZIP file directory valid RO-Crate bag. expected files bagit.txt BagIt definition data directory payload RO-Crate manifest-[algorithm].txt checksum file inside data directory; . , RO-Crate can displayed
code: basic_ro_crate_contents <- path_to_rocrate_bag |>   rocrateR::is_rocrate_bag() #> Valid RO-Crate found! print(basic_ro_crate_contents) #> { #>   "@context": "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/context", #>   "@graph": [ #>     { #>       "@id": "ro-crate-metadata.json", #>       "@type": "CreativeWork", #>       "about": { #>         "@id": "./" #>       }, #>       "conformsTo": { #>         "@id": "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2" #>       } #>     }, #>     { #>       "@id": "./", #>       "@type": "Dataset", #>       "name": "", #>       "description": "", #>       "datePublished": "2025-11-04", #>       "license": { #>         "@id": "http://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0" #>       } #>     } #>   ] #> }

For details, see: #> /tmp/RtmpJDledw/rocrate-dc0b8f71bc4ab2e85c9c47e17b4c6cfc/ROC  # create tree with the files fs::dir_tree(path_to_rocrate_bag_contents) #> /tmp/RtmpJDledw/rocrate-dc0b8f71bc4ab2e85c9c47e17b4c6cfc/ROC/. #> ├── bagit.txt #> ├── data #> │   └── ro-crate-metadata.json #> ├── manifest-sha512.txt #> └── tagmanifest-sha512.txt # delete temporary directory unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
text: develop RO-Crates, might want validate . validators online (can found https://www.researchobject.org/ro-crate/tools), explore Python package rocrate-validator. installation details, please visit https://github.com/crs4/rocrate-validator. ⚠️ validation workflow depends Python’s rocrate-validator. Ensure working Python installation {reticulate} configured correctly (reticulate::py_config()). Windows, may need restart R installation.

what: 6.3. Create example RO-Crate and validate it
title: RO-Crate R Package Wrapper
code: basic_ro_crate <- rocrateR::rocrate()  # store crate inside temporal directory tmp <- file.path(tempdir(), "ro-crate-metadata.json") basic_ro_crate |>   rocrateR::write_rocrate(tmp) # wrap crate into zip file (expected by validator) tmp_zip <- paste(tmp, ".zip") zip(tmp_zip, tmp)  # validate (note the name of the module: rocrate_validator) reticulate::use_virtualenv("rocrateR") rocrate_validator <- reticulate::import("rocrate_validator") status <- rocrate_validator$utils$validate_rocrate_uri(tmp_zip)  if (status) {   message("RO-Crate is valid!") } else {   message("RO-Crate is invalid!") } #> RO-Crate is valid!  # delete temporal files unlink(tmp) unlink(tmp_zip)

code: basic_crate <- rocrateR::rocrate()  # create entity for an organisation organisation_uol <- rocrateR::entity(   x = "https://ror.org/04xs57h96",   type = "Organization",   name = "University of Liverpool",   url = "http://www.liv.ac.uk" )  # create an entity for a person person_rvd <- rocrateR::entity(   x = "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5036-8661",   type = "Person",   name = "Roberto Villegas-Diaz",   affiliation = list(`@id` = organisation_uol$`@id`) )  basic_crate_person <- basic_crate |>   rocrateR::add_entity(person_rvd) |>   rocrateR::add_entity_value(id = "./", key = "author", value = list(`@id` = person_rvd$`@id`)) |>   rocrateR::add_entity(organisation_uol) |>   rocrateR::get_entity(person_rvd)    basic_crate_person[[1]]$name == person_rvd$name #> [1] TRUE basic_crate_person[[1]]$`@id` == person_rvd$`@id` #> [1] TRUE

title: Create a new RO-Crate object — rocrate
code: rocrate(   ...,   context = "https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/context",   conformsTo = gsub("\\/context$", "\\1", context),   datePublished = Sys.Date(),   description = "",   license = "http://spdx.org/licenses/CC-BY-4.0",   name = "" )

title: Create a new RO-Crate object — rocrate
text: ... Optional entities include RO-Crate (e.g., author). context String URL version RO-Crate specification use. context brings defined terms metadata document (default: https://w3id.org/ro/crate/1.2/context). conformsTo String URL version RO-Crate specification object conforms . Conformance declares RO-Crate conventions using terms followed (default: URL formed context/context) datePublished String (Date object) date RO-Crate published (default: current date). description String description root entity (default: empty string). license String URL (permalinks preferred, required) license used overall RO-Crate. See following resources license choices: https://spdx.org/licenses /https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/tree/main/jsonld (default: CC--4.0: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International). name String name/title root entity (default: empty string).
